snippet.description:
Can you really prepare for UPSC Mains in the 89 days between Prelims and Mains?

Santosh Sir explains why UPSC Mains preparation should be completed by December and what it actually means to be Mains-ready.

According to him, complete Mains preparation requires four key things:

Revision-ready notes covering the entire syllabus
UPSC Mains PYQs thoroughly studied and practised
Extensive answer writing practice
Being consistently updated with Current Affairs

The Mains Master Program (MMP) is designed around these four requirements. Over the next four months, students write around 500 answers, while Current Affairs is integrated with MMP through the Current Affairs Advance Program to ensure coverage beyond December as well.

The goal is simple: by the time Prelims arrives, your Mains preparation should already be done.
